title: Site Reliability Engineer
description: Apply software engineering practices to infrastructure operations: establish SLOs/SLAs, error budgets, incident automation, and resilience engineering.

goal.objective: Engineer automated systems that maximize platform reliability, maintain rigorous SLOs, and systematically eliminate manual operational toil.

learn.summary: Master Google SRE principles, Service Level Objectives (SLOs), error budgets, incident command systems, chaos engineering (Chaos Mesh), and automated remediation scripting.
key_competencies: Prometheus Alerting Rules & Burn Rate Alerts

capstone_projects.title: Automated Chaos Testing & SLO Dashboard Suite
capstone_projects.description: Build an automated chaos testing pipeline that injects network latency and pod crashes to validate multi-region failover and error budget tracking.

interview_focus: How to Calculate Multi-Window Multi-Burn-Rate Alerts
Automating Toil: Python vs Bash vs Custom Operator

tree.name: SRE Foundations: Systems, Programming & Principles
tree.description: Build a rock-solid understanding of operating systems, networking, a core programming language, database internals, and fundamental SRE principles to establish a robust operational mindset.

resources.title: Site Reliability Engineering Full Course (TechWorld with Nana)

children.name: Operating Systems & Networking Deep Dive
children.description: Master Linux/Unix operating systems including kernel concepts, process management, filesystems, and I/O. Gain expertise in advanced shell scripting and core networking concepts like the TCP/IP stack, DNS, HTTP/S, load balancing, firewalls (iptables/nftables), and network troubleshooting tools (tcpdump, netstat).

resources.title: Kubernetes Tutorial for Beginners (TechWorld with Nana)
Prometheus and Grafana Tutorial (TechWorld with Nana)

children.name: Programming & Scripting Proficiency
children.description: Gain proficiency in at least one general-purpose programming language (Python, Go, or Rust) for automation, tool development, and API interaction. Understand fundamental data structures, algorithms, and best practices for writing reliable, maintainable code.

resources.title: Docker Tutorial for Beginners (TechWorld with Nana)

children.name: Distributed Systems Advanced Concepts
children.description: Deepen understanding of the CAP theorem, various consistency models (strong, eventual), consensus algorithms (Raft, Paxos), and inter-service communication patterns (RPC, REST, gRPC). Explore message queues (Kafka, RabbitMQ), distributed databases, service discovery, and robust failure detection mechanisms.

resources.title: SLOs, SLIs, and SLAs Explained (Google Cloud)

children.name: Database Fundamentals for SRE
children.description: Understand operational aspects of relational databases (SQL, indexing, transactions, replication, backup/restore, connection pooling) and NoSQL databases (key-value, document, column-family, graph). Learn about common database reliability patterns, performance tuning, and monitoring strategies.

resources.title: Site Reliability Engineering Full Course (TechWorld with Nana)

tree.name: Cloud Native & Infrastructure Automation
tree.description: Master cloud platforms, containerization, orchestration, and automate infrastructure provisioning and configuration management for scalability, consistency, and reliability across environments.

resources.title: Kubernetes Tutorial for Beginners (TechWorld with Nana)
Prometheus and Grafana Tutorial (TechWorld with Nana)

children.name: Cloud Platforms & Serverless Architectures
children.description: Deep dive into major cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure), understanding IaaS, PaaS, and FaaS models. Explore virtual machines, cloud networking (VPCs, subnets), security groups, IAM, managed services, and cost management. Understand serverless architectures and their operational considerations.

resources.title: Docker Tutorial for Beginners (TechWorld with Nana)

children.name: Containerization & Orchestration
children.description: Gain a comprehensive understanding of Docker for containerization, including image building, registries, and container networking. Master Kubernetes for container orchestration, covering pods, deployments, services, ingress, persistent storage, security contexts, and Helm charts for package management.

resources.title: SLOs, SLIs, and SLAs Explained (Google Cloud)

children.name: Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
children.description: Learn to define and manage infrastructure declaratively using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools like Terraform or Pulumi. Understand state management, modularization, secrets integration, and applying IaC within CI/CD pipelines for reproducible and scalable infrastructure.

resources.title: Site Reliability Engineering Full Course (TechWorld with Nana)

children.name: Configuration Management
children.description: Automate server and application configuration using tools like Ansible. Understand idempotency, playbooks, roles, inventory management, and vaulting for secure secrets management. Integrate configuration management into infrastructure provisioning workflows.

resources.title: Kubernetes Tutorial for Beginners (TechWorld with Nana)
Prometheus and Grafana Tutorial (TechWorld with Nana)

tree.name: Observability & Proactive Reliability
tree.description: Implement comprehensive observability, define robust Service Level Objectives (SLOs), and build effective alerting strategies to proactively manage system health, performance, and user experience.

resources.title: Docker Tutorial for Beginners (TechWorld with Nana)

children.name: Metrics, Logs, and Traces with Tools
children.description: Deep dive into the three pillars of observability: metrics (Prometheus, Grafana), structured logging (ELK stack, Loki, Vector, Splunk), and distributed tracing (OpenTelemetry, Jaeger, Zipkin). Learn application and infrastructure instrumentation techniques, data aggregation, and correlation.

resources.title: SLOs, SLIs, and SLAs Explained (Google Cloud)

children.name: Service Level Objectives (SLOs) & Error Budgets Implementation
children.description: Define meaningful Service Level Indicators (SLIs) and Service Level Objectives (SLOs) that truly reflect user experience. Learn to implement, track, and report on error budgets, connecting reliability metrics directly to business goals and guiding product development priorities.

resources.title: Site Reliability Engineering Full Course (TechWorld with Nana)

children.name: Alerting Strategies, Paging & Runbooks
children.description: Design effective, actionable, and low-noise alerting strategies. Configure and manage paging systems (PagerDuty, Opsgenie), develop comprehensive runbooks for common incidents, and implement on-call best practices, including rotation, escalation policies, and fatigue management.

resources.title: Kubernetes Tutorial for Beginners (TechWorld with Nana)
Prometheus and Grafana Tutorial (TechWorld with Nana)

tree.name: Incident Management & Operational Excellence
tree.description: Master the incident response lifecycle, lead effective postmortems, and drive continuous improvement through strategic toil reduction and robust release engineering practices.

resources.title: Docker Tutorial for Beginners (TechWorld with Nana)

children.name: Incident Response & Blameless Postmortems
children.description: Master the incident response lifecycle: detection, declaration, communication (internal/external stakeholders), mitigation, and resolution. Understand and practice blameless postmortems, common incident roles (Incident Commander, Comms Lead, Scribe), and root cause analysis techniques (e.g., 5 Whys, Fishbone Diagram) to foster a culture of learning.

resources.title: SLOs, SLIs, and SLAs Explained (Google Cloud)

children.name: Toil Reduction & Automation Engineering
children.description: Identify, measure, and systematically eliminate toil through automation. Develop scripts, integrate APIs, build self-service tools, and embed automation into operational workflows. Promote a culture where repetitive manual tasks are continuously engineered away.

resources.title: Site Reliability Engineering Full Course (TechWorld with Nana)

children.name: Release Engineering & CI/CD for SRE
children.description: Understand SRE's critical role in the CI/CD pipeline. Implement reliable release strategies such as continuous delivery, progressive rollouts (canary deployments, blue/green deployments), and effective use of feature flags. Focus on automated testing, minimizing deployment risk, and ensuring fast, reliable rollbacks.

resources.title: Kubernetes Tutorial for Beginners (TechWorld with Nana)
Prometheus and Grafana Tutorial (TechWorld with Nana)

tree.name: Resilience, Security & Advanced SRE Practices
tree.description: Design and build highly resilient and secure systems, optimize for peak performance, plan for future growth, and drive a culture of continuous operational improvement through advanced SRE techniques.

resources.title: Docker Tutorial for Beginners (TechWorld with Nana)

children.name: Capacity Planning, Scalability & Performance Engineering
children.description: Forecast system resource needs, conduct load modeling, stress testing (k6, Locust, JMeter), and performance profiling. Optimize application and infrastructure performance to meet SLOs under expected and peak loads. Understand auto-scaling, elasticity patterns, and cost-efficiency.

resources.title: SLOs, SLIs, and SLAs Explained (Google Cloud)

children.name: Chaos Engineering, Disaster Recovery & BCP
children.description: Proactively identify weaknesses by systematically injecting failures into systems using Chaos Engineering tools (e.g., LitmusChaos, Gremlin, Chaos Mesh). Develop, test, and validate robust Disaster Recovery (DR) and Business Continuity Plans (BCP), including comprehensive backup strategies, data restoration, and failover/failback procedures.

resources.title: Site Reliability Engineering Full Course (TechWorld with Nana)

children.name: Security Fundamentals for SRE
children.description: Understand common security vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10), secure configuration practices, secrets management (Vault, AWS Secrets Manager), identity and access management (IAM) best practices, network security, and compliance basics. Advocate for integrating security into every stage of the software lifecycle.

resources.title: Kubernetes Tutorial for Beginners (TechWorld with Nana)
Prometheus and Grafana Tutorial (TechWorld with Nana)

children.name: Operational Readiness & Knowledge Management
children.description: Establish and implement processes for comprehensive operational readiness reviews before launching or significantly updating services. Create and maintain living documentation, including architectural diagrams, runbooks, troubleshooting guides, service catalogs, and post-incident reports. Foster a culture of knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.

resources.title: Docker Tutorial for Beginners (TechWorld with Nana)

children.name: Capstone Project: Building a Production-Grade Resilient Service
children.description: Apply all learned SRE principles by designing, deploying, and operating a highly observable, resilient, and secure service in a simulated production environment. Implement SLOs, comprehensive dashboards, effective alerts, automated deployments, robust capacity planning, and practice incident response and post-mortems for continuous improvement.
